factions.html.title: Factions of Zalesye
factions.html.intro: Meet the groups that shape the wasteland.

cards.title: Bandits
cards.description: Chaotic raiders who live by killing and stealing. They appear disorganized, but can quickly form large squads when hunting for supplies. They attack every faction they encounter, and their largest known base is at Svarog Factories near the highway. Encounters with Bandits are always lethal.

cards.title: Mudlarks
cards.description: A tribe of half-mutated people who are strangely resistant to Mist. They treat Mist like a deity, singing to it and performing rituals. They work near Lake Pavlie and are not naturally hostile unless their rituals grow more extreme.

cards.title: Mechanists
cards.description: Technically skilled workers who maintain machines, filters, tools, and gadgets for all other groups. They research radiation and Mist while keeping Zalesye infrastructure running. Their technology, especially water filters, is essential for survival.

cards.title: Rada
cards.description: A cooperative of farmers and traders who promote shared labour and equal distribution of resources. They run farms and hire Palatines for protection, though rumours suggest they use hired agents to eliminate rivals.

cards.title: Gunners
cards.description: A violent gang expanding rapidly across Zalesye. They run protection rackets and a growing drug trade with Mudlarks. They control the Water Treatment plant and push aggressively into Palatine territory.

cards.title: Commonfolk
cards.description: Ordinary people who belong to no faction. Many live in the Mire, farming, trading, or simply struggling to survive. Life in Zalesye has beaten many of them down.

cards.title: Acolytes
cards.description: Religious travellers who maintain churches, hospitals, and shelters. They provide medical aid, food, and refuge while spreading pre-war beliefs and competing with Rada for influence among Commonfolk.

cards.title: Palatines
cards.description: A military force formed from the remnants of war. They guard Arcadia and the Bastion, a defensive wall protecting Zalesye from mutants. Corruption and disorganization plague their ranks.

cards.title: Vultures
cards.description: A loose alliance of scavengers and roamers. They pick through ruins, trade scraps, clear Bandits, and take odd jobs. They are essential to Zalesye's economy despite receiving little respect.
